description: `cli package withdraw --help` prints its topic and withdraws nothing.

stdout.text:
Usage: prose [GLOBAL OPTIONS] cli package withdraw <ORG>/<NAME>@<VERSION> [--json]

Withdraw one version from discovery. Pinned retrieval of that exact version keeps
working.

Arguments:
  ORG/NAME@VERSION            Exact package version.

Options:
  --json                      Print one JSON result; the same as the global --output json.
  --help                      Show help for this command.

Examples:
  prose cli package withdraw acme/tool@1.0.0 --json

Output: openprose.package-operation/1 (--json).
Exit codes: 0 success; 2 invalid invocation or configuration; 10 service, credential or registry error; 24 interrupted.
